messages:
rita.sre: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to lock owners and deadlines for the latency incident yesterday. Link to doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2024-03-latency-runaway
kevin.prod: saw the draft. main asks: (1) SLO recalibration proposal, (2) dashboard widgets, (3) a recurring runbook test.
nora.pm: tagging rollout impact — product needs a clear SLA decision by EOD Fri so we can communicate to customers.
rita.sre: confirmed. Proposed immediate changes: reduce p95 SLO from 320ms to 420ms for model-inference route for 7 days while we stabilize; add p99 alert with 6m burn window; add synthetic check every 30s.
kevin.prod: can you add the exact alert thresholds? i.e. p99 > 900ms for 6m?
rita.sre: yes — p95 > 420ms sustained 10m => warn; p99 > 900ms for 6m => page oncall.
ops-bot: incident-bot: Error budget remaining for inference-service: 18% (30d window). Related alert: high p99 spikes detected 02:12-02:46 UTC.
alex.redis: re: root cause: cache eviction noise + autoscale lag. I'll own the eviction tuning and a quick fix to prioritize hot prefixes. ETA 48h.
kevin.prod: i'll own the SLO doc update and the SLA comms. ETA EOD Friday.
nora.pm: i'll coordinate customer comms and hold a sync with account leads once SLA decision is final.
rita.sre: Action list (short):
- alex.redis: add hot-prefix pinning and reduce cache TTL for small keys (48h)
- kevin.prod: update SLO/SLA doc + publish customer note (EOD Fri)
- ops-bot / infra: add synthetic check + Grafana panel (24h)
- rita.sre: run a 72h rolling test with load generator and capture p95/p99 every hour (start tomorrow)
Please confirm ownership & ETA.
kevin.prod: confirmed for SLO doc. will create PR and @ops-bot will pick up deploy.
alex.redis: confirmed for cache tuning, starting now. will post config diff in the thread when ready.
rita.sre: for dashboards — here's the queries we should add:
```
quantile_over_time(0.95, latency_ms[5m]) by (route)
quantile_over_time(0.99, latency_ms[5m]) by (route)
sum(rate(requests_total{route="/v1/infer"}[5m])) by (status)
```
please add as 1) p95 heatmap, 2) p99 alert, 3) throughput trend.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled dashboard update job created: job/inf-slo-panels in infra-ops. ETA 12h.
nora.pm: if the 7-day temporary SLO is accepted we should add a note in the postmortem with rollback criteria and who approves extension.
rita.sre: agreed. rollback criteria = sustained p95 < 360ms and error budget spend < 10% over the 7d window. Approver = SRE lead + PM.
kevin.prod: I'll draft the customer-facing phrasing and post here for review before sending.
alex.redis: config diff posted: https://redwood.internal/changes/eviction-tune-4781 — TTL reduced from 30m -> 8m for small keys, hot-pin for top 100 prefixes. Rolling restart plan included.
rita.sre: perfect. can you also add a canary on a single pool first?
alex.redis: yes, canary on pool-3 now. watching.
ops-bot: infra-monitor: canary pool-3 showing p95 drop from 480ms -> 380ms in first 10m.
rita.sre: :thumbsup: OK — next sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC to review telemetry and finalize SLA note. If anything pages in the meantime, call it out here.
kevin.prod: thanks all, will update the thread with PR + comms draft. :thumbsup:
